title: NyayaSetuPhase6BenchmarkSchema
description: Standardized schema for NyayaSetu Phase 6 Expanded Research Benchmark queries and ground truth records.

id.description: Unique identifier for the benchmark item (e.g., P6_DEV_001, P6_VAL_001, P6_TEST_001)

question.description: The natural language legal query or fact pattern

category.description: Primary failure mode or architectural evaluation category

sub_category.description: Specific sub-classification within the primary category

difficulty.description: Assessed complexity of retrieval and doctrinal reasoning

temporal_context.description: Temporal applicability constraint governing the legal fact pattern

legal_regimes_expected.description: List of expected routing legal regimes (e.g. BNS_SUBSTANTIVE, BNSS_PROCEDURAL, IT_ACT, GENERAL)

expected_issue_type.description: Formal legal issue identifier corresponding to research taxonomy

expected_statutes.description: Canonical statute titles governing the issue. Empty only for out-of-scope queries.

expected_answer_properties.description: Key substantive elements, punishment quantums, or procedural constraints expected

gold_evidence_ids.description: Target statutory document names or known chunk references in corpus

risk_level.description: Consequence risk of an erroneous or hallucinated answer

source_origin.description: Provenance of the question and gold labels (e.g., bar_council_exam_archive, dlsa_intake_curated, gazette_official)

annotated_claims.description: Atomic claim decomposition for evaluating Phase 5 claim grounding and citation verification

generated_answer.description: Candidate answer text for claim grounding validation

retrieved_evidence.description: Provided statutory evidence chunks for evaluating grounding
